entityculling:
Minecraft skips rendering things that are behind you, so why is it rendering everything that you still can't see because of walls or ceilings in the way?

This mod introduces asynchronous path-tracing to efficiently determine what's actually visible to the player. Using other available CPU cores, it calculates line-of-sight visibility in real time and eliminates unnecessary draw calls/processing for hidden block entities and entities.

This can drastically improve the frame rate, depending on the number of entities and the position in the world.

 

 

 Asynchronous Path-Tracing

- Uses spare CPU threads to calculate visibility
- Runs alongside the main game thread without blocking (every few ticks, required data will be collected on the main thread)
- Updates visibility data in real time, keeping pop-ins to a minimum

 Entity Tick Optimization

- Reduces client impact from entities that

distraction-free-recipes:
Distraction Free Recipes is a simple mod that helps to declutter your inventory interface by automatically hiding that huge list of items if you're not actively searching for anything. Currently, it supports EMI, REI, and JEI fully.

For new players who aren't used to modded Minecraft, opening your screen and being bombarded with hundreds of items filling up half the interface can be overwhelming, and often a surprisingly large barrier to entry. Given that it's not really necessary to view the entire item list all at once at all times, it makes sense to auto-hide the item list to help with accessibility for new players.

There is also an additional option (default: off) to reduce the opacity of the somewhat ugly vanilla search box, which helps it blend in to the backgrund a little more, and an option to show a text saying "Search to View Recipes" to help confused players who may think JE

autotag:
This is a purely technical mod with the aim to increase inter-mod compatibility. By "purely technical" I mean that it won't add any content to your game.

 The Problem

Mod creators are encouraged to use tags where possible, e.g. when creating a recipe. If mods are supposed to work together though, they should all share a same base of common "conventional" tags, which group certain items together. Not all developers add their items to common tags though, which means that a person playing with many mods or a mod pack creator might need to create long lists of all items which fulfill certain criteria to add them to specific tags.

 The Solution

Upon loading a world, this mod will automatically populate some tags based on code conditions, covering all modded content as well.

It's mostly relevant for mod pack creators who need / want to configure mods by adding to specific tags - this allo

you are probably thinking: "Yeah I don't get scammed, I am not stupid!" but are you always under full awareness?

ScamScreener is designed to keep you safe while you are distraced, by people trying to scam you. 

 How does ScamScreener work?
When a player sends a message into the chat, the mod reads it and compares it against its locally stored rules and weights. The Message reaches the Detection Pipeline and from here each Step adds Points to the message from 0 to 100. 
Above a certain threshold you'll receive a warning that this message might be kinda sus.

 Does ScamScreener learn?
Yeah kind of. But only if you, the community participate. The Mod uses Cases to identify Scam Behavior over several messages. You can manually share them to the ScamScreener Hub where only the messages and the pipeline results gets stored and bundled to improve the rulesets. The Mod does not know any Player

Molten Vents is a mod which adds a renewable source of the orestones found in the Create mod, and by extension the many resources that can be processed from them.

 

 How to use: 
- Locate a vent; Vents are found anywhere on the surface, but are more easily found underwater. (Configurable) 
- Dig out the blocks inside of the vent until you find a block that looks like the orestones the vent is made of except with magma on it, that is the dormant orestone . 
- Explode the dormant orestone by any means. 
- Notice that the dormant molten vent is now an active molten vent by seeing the magma in it become brighter. 
- Dump lava (preferrably via an automated method) on the active molten vent and watch as the lava turns into the corresponding orestone. 
- Process the orestones into resources, or use them for building. 

 Default Vents: 
- Veridium Vent
- Asurine Vent
- Crimsite Vent
- Ochrum V

common-storage-lib:
Common Storage Lib

CSL attempts to pick up where Botarium left off in its efforts to make truly cross platform storage implementations possible. CSL, like its predecessor, allows developers to create platform agnostic storage code that can be registered to Fabric and NeoForge's respective APIs. It takes after Fabric's Storage api with immutable resources and item context, but adopts Forge's simulation system.

Unlike its predecessor, CSL makes its abstraction tools that made it possible open for you to use as well. So in addition to abstraction of storage, CSL provides abstraction of fluid resources and ingredients, abstraction of the Data attachment system provided by NeoForge and Fabric, and an abstraction of both loaders "Entity Systems" api (Capabilities on NeoForge, ApiLookup on Fabric). These apis are each in their own module, allowing you to use them independently of the storage

Mcedia Core 是一个客户端媒体播放模组，为 Minecraft 提供本地运行的媒体播放基础能力，重点放在游戏内视频画面渲染、音频播放、弹幕显示以及播放性能控制。

它面向需要在客户端内加载和播放媒体内容的使用场景，提供稳定的播放宿主、屏幕渲染能力，以及围绕解码与上传开销的运行时调度。

 主要特性

- 在客户端内播放媒体内容，并将画面渲染到游戏世界中的屏幕表面
- 支持空间音频播放，可结合左右声道实现更有方向感的声音表现
- 支持弹幕显示，可按需开启或关闭
- 提供全局视频音量控制，并集成到原版声音设置界面
- 支持播放过程中的基础控制，包括暂停、恢复、倍速与跳转
- 提供分辨率上限、活跃解码器数量、节流解码器数量等性能相关配置
- 对不可见或距离较远的播放实例进行节流或挂起，降低不必要的解码与纹理上传开销
- 在检测到 Sound Physics Remastered 时启用兼容，使视频声音可参与物理声效处理

 性能与行为

Mcedia Core 不只是简单地“播放视频”，还会根据可见性与距离动态管理解码器状态：

- 优先保证当前可见、正在播放的内容
- 对次要内容启用低开销模式
- 对长时间不需要更新的内容暂停解码
- 在屏幕不可见时跳过纹理上传，减少客户端负担

这使它在存在多个播放实例时，仍能尽量维持可用的性能表现。

 配置项

模组当前提供的可调项主要包括：

- 最大视频分辨率上限
- 全局音量倍率
- 活跃解码器数量上限
- 节流解码器数量上限
- 低开销上传帧率
- 弹幕显示开关

这些设置会保存在客户端配置文件中，并在游戏启动时自动加载。

alternate-current-unofficial:
Alternate Current Unofficial is an efficient and non-locational redstone dust implementation. Its main focus lies in reducing the lag caused by redstone dust, by optimizing the power calculations and reducing the number of shape and block updates emitted. As a side effect of these changes the block update order of redstone dust networks is predictable and intuitive rather than locational and chaotic.

This is an unofficial 1.7.10 and 1.12.2 forge port of the Alternate Current mod for legacy fabric. Please support the original work.

Smithing in Minecraft is incredibly stingy. NBT Exporter

NBT Exporter is a simple client-side mod that allows players to export NBT data of items from their inventory.

 Usage
Hold the item you want to export NBT for, and use the /exportnbt command.

You can use it like that:
 
/exportnbt MyUniqueItem
 

...or like that:
 
/exportnbt "My Unique Item, but with spaces"
 

Providing a file name is optional. If not specified, the file will use the current date and time as the name.

To view the tags in an exported .nbt file, you can use a file reader such as NBTExplorer.

You can use this command on any Minecraft server without requiring additional permissions unless prohibited by server rules.

 Commands
Since v2.0 NBT Exporter provides these commands:

 /exportnbt exports item NBT only, in compressed binary format
 /exportstack exports full information about the item as NBT (incl. id & count & damage), in compressed binary format

syrup-library:
Syrup Library

Syrup Library is a shared library used by Syrup Studios mods. It mainly provides reusable typed configuration code so we don't have to reimplement the same systems for every mod and loader.

If you're a player, you usually only need to install this because another Syrup Studios mod depends on it. It doesn't add much on its own.

Make sure you're using the version that matches both your Minecraft version and mod loader.

 For developers

Syrup Library is available from the Syrup Studios Maven repository:

 kotlin
repositories {
 maven("https://maven.syrupstudios.net/releases/")
}
 

Versions use this format:

 text
net.syrupstudios:syrup library:0.3.0+ - 
 

For example, Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric:

 kotlin
dependencies {
 modImplementation("net.syrupstudios:syrup library:0.3.0+1.20.1-fabric")
}

lan-announcer:
LAN Announcer

Announces the server to the LAN using multicast UDP.

Sends an announcement packet every 1.5 seconds on both IPv4 and IPv6, similar to how the normal Minecraft client does when you "Open to LAN".

Makes the server automagically appear on all Minecraft clients on the same local network.

Really nice when making home server for LANs or for the kids.

 Technical details
Every 1.5 seconds it sends the payload:

 
[MOTD] [/MOTD][AD] [/AD]
 

For example:

 
[MOTD]A Minecraft Server[/MOTD][AD]25565[/AD]
 

Over UDP port 4445 to the IP addresses:
- 224.0.2.60 
- ff75:230::60

retina:
Retina is a raycasting library data pack for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.20+, using voxel traversal. 

Unlike other similar packs, it supports (almost) all of the different hitboxes, including both blocks & entities. It also doesn't rely on entity teleportation, meaning it runs slightly faster on average too.

Additionally, Retina supports a lot of customizable input parameters and gives detailed output information, making it a very useful resource for custom maps and datapacks, with applications ranging from magic wands to guns to custom block placing to laser beams.

For more specific information, check out the GitHub repository.

unmending:
This is an updated and ported version of Vazkii's mod Unmending.

---

Unmending is a very simple mod that nerfs Mending without making it useless. Should you install it, you'll find the following changes in your game:

- Items that already have the Mending enchantment will no longer repair with XP.
- Mending can no longer be applied as an enchantment.
- Applying a Mending book to an item resets the "extra repair cost" that accumulates as you repair an item, thus preventing "Too Expensive!". You can do this as many times as you want.

render-distant-players:
This mod renders players from beyond eachother's render distances if there are no blocks in the way. The server side raycasts between two player's eye levels and if there are no blocks in the way, it sends a packet to the client side telling it to render a scaled down player model where they would have been.

 

This mod is currently in a very alpha stage. Bug reports are appreciated. 

 

This mod was primarily designed to be compatible with Diamond Star Combat so you can see other planes from beyond your render distance.
creativerse:
What is Creativerse?

Creativerse is a data pack which generates a secondary overworld in your survival world - the creativerse!
This place is then used as a creative mode playground for
- prebuilding structures
- testing redstone machines
- experimenting with block palettes and gradients
- everything else you'd do in a creative world

Every player has separate inventories for both worlds!

 Play with friends regardless of playstyle

I created creativerse with the intention to unite my creative mode friends with my survival mode buddies on one server to hang out without interfering with each others playstyle.

 How to use

- /trigger creativerse info gives you all the information you need
- /trigger creativerse enter lets you enter the creativerse
- /trigger creativerse exit returns you to the overworld
- /trigger creativerse sync clones a 16x16x16 area from the overworld to the creative

CobbleRogue is a Cobblemon Roguelike side-mod inspired by elements from popular Pokemon roguelike fan projects, such as PokeRogue and Pokemon Emerald Rogue

Features:

- If one of your Pokemon faint in battle, they're permadead. You can't access them anymore. If all of your Pokemon die, you can pick a new starter.
- Revives and Max Revives can be used to temporarily resurrect and/or save a Pokemon if they died in that battle. This is referred to as a Final Stand. It will retain it's level, stats, ect.
If the resurrected Pokemon is not active when the battle ends, they will proceed to be permanently erased.

The Minecraft feedback discord states that "Villagers arent interested in being...enslaved." However, current mechanics in the game allow players to trap villagers in 1x1 cubicals for forced trading.  TaCZ Recipe Fix

This mod solves a common problem with Timeless and Classics Guns (TaCZ) addon gun packs: guns show up in the game, but their crafting recipes never appear, so you can't craft them at the Gun Smith Table.

message-encryption:
Message Encryption

This mod lets you encrypt messages end-to-end.

 Usage

This mod modifies the /msg command to automatically try to send encrypted messages. You can use /nmsg to send using the vanilla message command, or you can use /emsg to only send encrypted messages.

To send encrypted messages the recipient must also have this mod. So to create an encrypted conversation, you need to ask the recipient to also install this mod.

 Other Info

This mod does not support /r , which means if a server has that command, it's going to use the server's messaging system, which is not encrypted. Please use /re for encrypted replies, it does the same thing like /r , but encrypted.

You can always check the source and make merge requests to add new features which this mod is going for.

This mod does not support non-premium accounts, and it is not going to.

You can use this mod in modpacks.

- Adds penalties (adverse potion-effects) for using beds inside villages, increasing risk.
 

- Prevents beds from dropping in villages, making them rarer.

- Disables phantom spawning (no penalty for skipping sleep).

 Chunk Challenge is a Fabric mod that turns Minecraft into a progressive survival challenge — one chunk at a time.

Every time you enter a new chunk, the world transforms around you: a randomized mob appears, a personal border locks you in, and all blocks in the chunk are replaced with one randomly selected block type . Clear the challenge, earn reward chests, and move on.

- Per-player WorldBorder that locks you inside the current chunk 
- Random mob spawn inside the chunk 
- Chunk block replacement: every block in the chunk becomes the same random block 
- Optional loot rewards for clearing chunks (with milestones) 

Progress is tracked per player and saved per world.

Size Matters is a roleplay-centric mod that adds the unique trait of height to the game.

Upon joining a world for the first time, players will be assigned a random permanent height ranging from 70% to 130% of normal height.

3. Saves that number in the players unique user data (sizematters.size data:player height)
4. Applies the number to the players height and width

 
\

Lumiera

Lumiera is a camera and cutscene tool for Minecraft. You build camera shots from
keyframes on an in-game timeline, hang timed events like fades, sound, and screen
shake off the path, and play the whole thing back from a key, a command, or a
datapack.

you build in one place works the same everywhere the mod is installed.

 What you can do

- Drop camera keyframes as you fly around, then scrub the timeline and preview the
 result live.
- Choose how the camera moves between keyframes: straight lines, Catmull-Rom,
 Bezier with handles, cosine, or a stepped hold. Centripetal Catmull-Rom is the
 safe default; it won't loop on sharp turns.
- Set easing per segment. Plain ease in/out is there, along with quad, cubic, sine,
 expo, back, elastic, and bounce, all solved as real cubic-bezier curves.

lc3dm:
Lumina's Custom: 3D Models

Lumina's Custom is a Minecraft rendering mod that loads real external 3D assets into the game — with their rigs, bones, materials, morphs, and animation systems intact. The point is to step outside the cube workflow and use models that come straight from standard 3D pipelines, without sacrificing too much performance in the process.

Everything runs through a preset system. A preset isn't just a model file — it's the full package: the 3D asset itself, its render config, its materials, the scale/position/rotation tweaks, optional physics (mmd only), animation files, and the animation states tied to gameplay logic.

So a preset really defines how a model exists inside Minecraft, not just what it looks like. If animations are part of it, the preset also maps which clip plays in which state. A player preset assigns walk, sprint, jump, idle, swim, attack animations

Lumina's Custom：商品3D模型 Lumina's Custom是一款Minecraft渲染模组，它可以将真实的外部3D资源加载到游戏中--其中的装备、骨骼、材质、变形和动画系统都完好无损。其要点是跳出立方体工作流程，使用直接来自标准3D管道的模型，而不会在此过程中牺牲太多性能。 一切都通过预设系统运行。预设不仅仅是一个模型文件-它是完整的包：3D资源本身，渲染配置，材质，缩放/位置/旋转调整，可选物理（仅限mmd），动画文件以及与游戏逻辑相关的动画状态。 因此，预设实际上定义了模型在Minecraft中的存在方式，而不仅仅是它的外观。如果动画是其中的一部分，则预设还映射了哪个剪辑在哪个状态下播放。玩家预设指定行走，冲刺，跳跃，空闲，游泳，攻击动画

swingsync:
The vanilla attack cooldown indicator is a tiny icon sitting right at your crosshair — the exact spot you need to be watching your opponent. SwingSync moves that information out of the way and turns it into a proper bar on your HUD, so you always know when to swing without breaking your focus.

What it does

It shows your weapon cooldown as a clean horizontal bar that changes color as it charges. Red means not ready, yellow means charging, green means hit. When you hit full charge, the screen edges flash briefly so you feel it even in the middle of a hectic fight.

The bar only shows up when you are actually holding a weapon. Any other time it stays out of your way.

Why it helps

In sword or axe PvP, the difference between a full charge hit and a half charge hit is massive. Most players either stare at the crosshair icon and lose track of their opponent, or ignore it entirely and swing

Join our Discord! 

 
 RedstoneAwareEdits

Tired of your redstone circuits breaking every time you use WorldEdit? RedstoneAwareEdits fixes that.

When you //paste , //stack , //move , or use any other WorldEdit/FAWE command, redstone components like dust, repeaters, comparators, and torches pop off or lose their state because Minecraft fires block updates during placement. This mod suppresses those updates and restores correct redstone states afterward — automatically.

 How It Works

 Two-phase protection: 
1. Suppress — During bulk block operations, all neighbor updates, onPlace callbacks, and shape recalculations are suppressed for redstone components
2. Restore — After placement completes, correct block states are recomputed and a single clean update pass runs

The mod auto-detects bulk operations (10+ blocks placed in one tick) and protects redstone without any commands needed. Just

schworlium:
Schworlium is a Worley-noise cave generation mod for Minecraft 26.2.x and 1.21.11 targeting both Fabric and NeoForge. Right now, It's essentially an opinionated port of SuperFluke's Worley's Caves, but it will eventually diverge into a more fleshed-out spelunking mod.

As expected, the carver replaces vanilla's caves with hollow networks shaped by 3D Worley noise.
 
The two substantive changes that pulled the project away from being a 1:1 port are a smoother carve and a taller working range. The original implementation contained jittery per-block math in its noise sampling and threshold logic that produced visibly clunky walls and "stepping" within tunnels. This has been replaced with the smoothing approach used in Worlium, yielding cleaner surfaces and more coherent cave shapes. Separately, the carver has been adapted to the post-1.18 extended world height.

stealth-by-karl-karlmann: The Problem In vanilla Minecraft, mobs have a fixed detection radius. As soon as you cross that invisible boundary, they instantly know your location—regardless of whether you are standing in pitch-black darkness, behind a solid wall, or two floors above them. This mod fixes that issue by giving mobs actual vision and hearing. Core Features True Line of Sight: Mobs now have realistic vision. They cannot see you through walls, and their sight is significantly reduced in the dark. Dynamic Hearing: We utilize the vanilla Warden's acoustic system in the background. Mobs will now register footsteps, broken blocks, or thrown items. They won't attack out of nowhere anymore; they have to actually notice you. Alert System: If mobs hear a noise but can't see you, their internal alert level rises. They will get nervous, investigate the area, and look around for the source of the sound. Stealth HUD:

init code here

tick (loop) code here

FFWaterFalls

Liquid source blocks fall under gravity, one block at a time, just like sand or gravel. Water, lava and modded fluids all get in on the fun, and you can watch every step of the fall.

 

 How it works

- Water, lava and modded liquid sources fall when nothing holds them up.
- Lava falls more slowly than water.
- Falling water can pass through fences and other waterloggable blocks, waterlogging them on the way down.
- Water and lava still react mid-fall, like lava landing on water.
- Oceans, lakes and other natural liquids stay put until something disturbs them, like breaking a block beside them.
- Built-in limits keep big collapses from turning into lag.

 Configuration

- Whether liquids pass through waterloggable b

Magical Gems: A mod for armor and potions.
---

Magical Gems is a Minecraft 1.16 mod that lets you define the effects of potions on armor pieces. 

 Gems

Gems are items that add effects to armor. To add these effects, simply place your piece of armor and the gem in an anvil.

 

 Alchemy table

The alchemy table is used to create gems.

First, place a normal gem in the "Gem slot".

Next, place the potion corresponding to the gem's effect or "essence".

Finally, you'll need to put in enhanced fire powder as fuel.

 

 Distillery

The distillery allows you to create potions that don't exist in the vanilla game, such as the haste potion.

First, place an empty vial in the exit slot.

Next, place the potion and the required item in the corresponding slots.

Lastly, you'll need to use improved fire powder as fuel.

almost-double-shulker-shells:
Obtaining large numbers of Shulker Boxes is a common issue in vanilla. In Bedrock Edition however, Shulkers can drop one more Shulker Shell per level of Looting! This means that, with Looting III, they can drop up to 4 shells! (In Java Edition, Looting only makes a Shulker more likely to drop 1 shell).

This data pack changes the Shulker loot table to function the same as in Bedrock Edition, BUT with a limit of 2 Shulker Shells per Shulker (they only have two shells anyway), instead with an increasing chance to get 2. This makes it a more balanced alternative to a guaranteed 2 Shulker Shell drop, as it requires the player to put in the effort for Looting to maximize the number of Shulker Shells while still not promising 2, keeping it from feeling overpowered and non-vanilla. It is effectively a cross between the Java and Bedrock loot tables for Shulkers.

Almost Double Shulker Shells is

The barrier expands as the player takes damage. (READ THIS!)
 How to install?
1. Download the datapack .zip file. 
2. Create new world and click More/Data Packs 
3. Click Open Pack Folder and place the downloaded .zip file into opened folder. 
4. Create your world. 
5. Run /trigger start in chat to activate the border. 
6. You’re done! The datapack is now installed and ready to use.
 Functions
- After starting a game, the world border is set to 1x1 block , centered on the player’s spawn point. 
- Every time the player takes damage, the datapack checks the lost health and increases the border size. 
- Expansion ratio: 1 HP (half a heart) = +0.5 block to the world border. 
- The border always grows evenly in all directions from its center.
- Don't worry about the datapack incompatibility message, because it has been tested on all versions listed in the version file.

About

This library has a modular structure that separates the API and internal components. This makes it easy to maintain the library and import only the necessary modules into projects, which allows to reduce the file size and decreases the load on the server.

You can check out the wiki if you want to learn more about this library🎓

 Why make another library?

I decided to write this library because I was tired of writing the same thing over and over again in my datapacks.
Why not just use existing libraries? In my opinion, they are bad. Some of them are too complicated, some are prematurely optimized, and some are just bad🥀
I wanted to find a middle ground between optimization, develop time, and simplicity of use. So I created another library, yeah😓

UHC Pack for Minecraft Java Edition 

A datapack for Minecraft Java Edition for running Ultra Hardcore (UHC) tournaments.
 
 Currently supported Minecraft versions: 

1.21.x
1.20.x
1.19.x
1.18.x

Earlier versions are not compatible due to the use of new command in the datapack. More recent versions (including snapshots) may be compatible but are not actively supported until a stable release is available.
 
 How to setup : 

Download the zip file for the latest release of the datapack.

Place the zip file in in the /datapacks/ folder.

Run /reload (or /minecraft:reload on Spigot/Paper) on your server to detect the new datapack

Decide the center of your map and teleport to it e.g. /tp @s 0 ~ 0 

Run /function uhc pack:setup to prepare the Lobby

From here, you can control the rest of the setup from the book provided.
 

By default, only the player who set up will be able to start the UHC

No Pumpkin Blur

No Pumpkin Blur removes the overlay you see while wearing a carved pumpkin, so your view stays clear. Endermen still ignore you as usual.

 

 What changes

- The carved pumpkin overlay ( textures/misc/pumpkinblur.png ) is fully transparent.
- Nothing else changes. The pumpkin still looks the same on your head for other players.

 Compatibility

- Minecraft: Java Edition 1.20 to 26.3 in one file (also 26.4 snapshots up to snapshot 10).
- Client-side: works in singleplayer and on any server, with or without mods.
- Tested in game on 26.3.

 FAQ

 Does it work on servers? Yes. It only changes one texture on your side.

 Does it work with Sodium, Iris or OptiFine? Yes. It replaces a texture, not a shader.

 Do Endermen still ignore me? Yes. The pumpkin works exactly as in vanilla, you just see through it.

 Installation

1. Download the file. Do not unzip it.
2. In Minecraf

为 Zume 模组（一个功能丰富的 Minecraft 缩放模组）提供的非官方简体中文语言包。

 这个资源包做了什么？
- 将 Zume 模组的所有游戏内文本翻译为简体中文，包括：
 - 配置界面的分类和选项
 - 每一项设置的工具提示
 - 按键绑定的名称和描述
 - HUD 元素与弹窗提示
- 提供基于 Zume 1.2.2 版本的完整 zh cn.json 文件。
- 不修改 任何纹理、模型或游戏机制 – 纯本地化资源包。

 为什么要使用它？
如果你是中文玩家，本包可以让你无需猜测或借助外部翻译工具，就能理解 Zume 的每一个选项。它能节省时间、避免配置错误，并让模组完全可用。

 兼容性
- 模组加载器：Forge、Fabric、NeoForge（任何支持 Zume 的版本）。
- Minecraft 版本：涵盖 1.14~1.21.11 以及 1.12~1.6.4（翻译应适用于 Zume 1.2.2 或其兼容版本运行的环境）。
- 依赖：需要安装 zume 模组本身。
- 翻译基于 Zume 1.2.2，如果模组没有太大的注册名改动， 理论上 应该可以向后兼容或向前兼容。

 重要信息
- 这是一个 资源包 ，不是模组。安装方法：将下载的 .zip 文件放入 .minecraft/resourcepacks 文件夹，然后在 选项 → 资源包 中启用。为达到最佳效果，请将其置于其他语言包之上。
- 许可证：本翻译采用 ARR (All Rights Reserved) 许可证。原模组作者为 Nolij，可在 Modrinth 上找到。
- 无自动更新 – 当 Zume 更新时，请回来查看本包的新版本。

 备注
如果你发现任何翻译错误或遗漏，欢迎留言评论。

本包仅影响 Zume 模组，不会改变其他模组或原版 Minecraft 的内容。

享受完全本地化的缩放体验！ 🐟

Cursed View is not your typical shaderpack. 

 

 

This shader was created to intentionally break the visual norms of Minecraft. 
Instead of aiming for beauty or realism, it dives headfirst into chaos, distortion, and discomfort.

 

With Cursed View, you’ll experience:

 Overexposed lighting that burns your world in light
 Colors that look like they're fighting each other
 Shadows that don’t behave like they should
 Blocks and entities that feel off, distorted, or almost corrupted
 A surreal atmosphere that turns peaceful villages into cursed zones

 

The goal is simple: make Minecraft look wrong — and weirdly fascinating. 
Whether you're exploring glitchcore builds, recording cursed videos, or just want to mess with your perception, 
Cursed View delivers an experience that no "normal" shader would dare attempt.

It doesn’t aim to be pretty. 
It doesn’t aim to be playable. 
It exists

betterreload:
BetterReload

Let's be honest, Bukkit's reload command is based on a flawed idea which often ends up causing more problems than
benefits. It's to the point where forks like Spigot and Paper have added messages warning users against the use of the
command, telling them to rather restart the server. So, what if the reload command was replaced entirely by a better
system?

Inspired by the SpongePowered project, BetterReload swaps Bukkit's attempt
at literally reloading all plugins to an event that is passed along to plugins instead. Upon issuing the /reload
command with BetterReload installed, plugins that depend on BetterReload can receive an event that leaves the reloading
process up to the plugins.

As of update 1.4.0, the plugin also includes a configurable system allowing any plugin to be supported via the external
section of the config.yml file. Please read more about this here.

- Console logging with custom messages

SpyCore

 
 
 
 
 

SpyCore is a multi-world management plugin for Paper and Purpur (1.21+).

Traditional multi-world plugins dump every single world folder directly into your server root, which gets messy quickly on larger servers or minigame networks. SpyCore organizes worlds into categorized subfolders (called containers ) using a virtual file system (VFS), while still letting you reference them with clean, simple world names in commands and APIs.

It also comes with built-in world hibernation to save RAM, fast template cloning for minigame arenas, per-world rule toggles (PVP, hunger, flight, autoheal), and target selector support ( @a , @p , @s , @r , @e ).

---

 Features

- Folder-based World Organization (VFS) : Keep your worlds organized. Group minigames, arenas, or seasonal worlds into subdirectories like spycore-worlds/Bedwars/Solo1 while players and scripts simply refer to Sol

ssaspawnerlimiter:
SSAddon SpawnerLimiter

SSAddon (SmartSpawner Addon) that limits spawner placement per chunk and per player based on spawner stacks, with Folia support!

 
 
 

 How It Works

SSASpawnerLimiter provides two independent limit systems :

 Chunk-Based Limit

 

Limits spawner stacks per chunk to prevent chunk overloading:
- 1 spawner block with 64 stacks = 64 count 
- 1 spawner block with 6 stacks = 6 count 
- Total in chunk : 70 count
- Default: 100 spawners per chunk

 Per-Player Limit

 

Limits total spawner stacks a player can place globally:
- Tracks all spawners placed by each player across the entire server
- Default: 1000 spawners per player
- Can be increased via permission nodes (1500, 2000, 5000, etc.)
- Bypass permission for unlimited spawners

 Both systems can be enabled/disabled independently in config.yml : 
 yaml
enable chunk limit: true Enable chunk-based limiting
enable
